digest.en: US President Trump faces scrutiny over a new ceasefire proposal for Ukraine after speaking with Russian President Putin. Gaza flotilla organisers claim 211 activists were "kidnapped" by Israel. Tensions rise as Iran vows to protect its nuclear capabilities and signals new rules for the Strait of Hormuz.
digest.hi: इज़रायल और हिजबुल्लाह के बीच संघर्ष बढ़ रहा है। बम और बारूद की इस टकराव में मौतें हो रही हैं। असम के मुख्यमंत्री ने भारत और बांग्लादेश के बीच संबंधों में सुधार की प्रार्थना की है।

articles.title: Zelensky demands Trump explain new ceasefire proposal after Putin’s call with US president
articles.summary: US President Trump had a "very good" phone call with Russian President Putin, who offered a ceasefire in Ukraine on Victory Day. The offer was welcomed by Trump. Ukraine-Russia war latest: Trump welcomes Putin’s offer of Victory Day ceasefire in ‘very good’ phone call The Independent.

articles.title: Gaza flotilla organisers say 211 activists ‘kidnapped’ by Israel
articles.summary: Israeli authorities have detained 211 activists attempting to reach Gaza by sea. Israel's Foreign Ministry says the activists are being taken to Israel peacefully, contradicting claims of kidnapping by the flotilla organisers.

articles.title: Trump in fresh attack on Germany's Merz over Iran
articles.summary: Donald Trump has launched a fresh attack on German politician Friedrich Merz, accusing him of interfering with efforts to curb Iran's nuclear programme. Trump claims Merz should focus on making the world a safer place.

articles.title: Iran vows to protect its nuclear capabilities, signals ‘new rules’ for Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, has vowed to protect the country's nuclear capabilities and establish new rules for the Strait of Hormuz. He blames US presence for insecurity in the region.

articles.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader Signals Plan to Maintain Control Over Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, has announced plans to establish new legal frameworks for the Strait of Hormuz and maintain control over the waterway. He also reaffirmed Iran's commitment to its nuclear capabilities.

articles.title: Myanmar ex-leader Aung San Suu Kyi moved to house arrest, military says
articles.summary: Myanmar's military has moved Aung San Suu Kyi to house arrest, a year after she was ousted in a military coup. Suu Kyi, a Nobel Peace Prize laureate, has been in detention since 2021.

articles.title: US naval blockade squeezes Iran's oil exports, forces crude onto floating storage
articles.summary: Iran's oil exports have been slashed by over 80 per cent. Only 4 million barrels have been exported. Iran’s oil exports have been slashed by over 80 per cent, with analysts saying only “around 4 million barrels” have made it out.

articles.title: Israel may have to 'act again' against Iran, Defence Minister Katz says
articles.summary: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will be free from American presence. Pakistan is engaged with the US and Iran to end the war in West Asia.

articles.title: Russia rejects Mali rebels' call to withdraw
articles.summary: Russia rejected Mali rebels' call to withdraw after its Africa Corps unit pulled out of a key town. Last weekend, Moscow's Africa Corps paramilitary unit pulled out of a key northern town in rebel attacks that also targeted the country's capital and killed the defence minister.

articles.title: Israel Intercepts Aid Flotilla Heading to Breach Naval Blockade of Gaza
articles.summary: Israel intercepted a flotilla heading to Gaza in international waters near Greece. The military boarded and disabled boats carrying humanitarian assistance. Activists said the Israeli military boarded and disabled boats carrying humanitarian assistance to the territory in international waters near Greece.

articles.title: Hezbollah hitting Israel with fiber-optic drones that can’t be jammed
articles.summary: Hezbollah is using fiber-optic drones that can't be jammed to hit Israel. Hezbollah hitting Israel with fiber-optic drones that can’t be jammed.

articles.title: Israel intercepts Gaza flotilla near Crete and detains 175 activists
articles.summary: Israel intercepted a Gaza flotilla near Crete and detained 175 activists. Pro-Palestinian activists say 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza were illegally intercepted in international waters near the Greek island.

articles.title: Man sentenced to death for murder of toddlers at Ugandan nursery
articles.summary: Christopher Okello Onyum was sentenced to death for murdering toddlers at a Ugandan nursery. Christopher Okello Onyum had pleaded insanity but this was dismissed by the judge. Man sentenced to death for murder of toddlers at Ugandan nursery.

articles.title: Israeli Defence Minister Says Country May Have To "Act Again" Against Iran
articles.summary: Israel's defence minister said the country may have to act against Iran again to ensure it does not become a threat. Israel's defence minister on Thursday said his country may soon have to "act again" against Iran, to ensure the Islamic republic "does not once again become a threat to Israel".

articles.title: US charges Sinaloa governor and other Mexican officials with drug trafficking offences
articles.summary: The US charged Sinaloa's governor and 9 Mexican officials with drug trafficking and kidnapping.

articles.title: Iran war is supercharging the clean energy transition, UN climate chief says
articles.summary: The UN climate chief said the Iran war is aiding the clean energy transition. Iran war is supercharging the clean energy transition, UN climate chief says Reuters.

articles.title: Hormuz Crisis Earns Trump New, Unfortunate, Nickname
articles.summary: Bloomberg columnist Javier Blas coined a new nickname for Trump amid the Hormuz Crisis. The nickname was coined by Bloomberg columnist Javier Blas. Hormuz Crisis Earns Trump New, Unfortunate, Nickname.

articles.title: Journalist Detained in Kuwait Says He Was Stripped of Citizenship
articles.summary: Kuwaiti-American journalist Ahmed Shihab-Eldin was detained and stripped of citizenship after posting about the Iran war. Ahmed Shihab-Eldin, a Kuwaiti-American, was held for several weeks after posting about the Iran war.

articles.title: Pakistan throws open emergency land routes to Iran as Hormuz blockade continues
articles.summary: Pakistan opened emergency land routes to Iran due to the Hormuz blockade. Pakistan throws open emergency land routes to Iran as Hormuz blockade continues.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia to end LIV Golf funding, while league appoints new chairman
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia will end funding for LIV Golf as the league seeks a new investment model with multiple partners. League says it wants to move towards an investment model involving multiple partners and team franchises.

articles.title: Attacks on Jewish Targets in Europe Suggest Hybrid Warfare
articles.summary: A shadowy Islamist group claimed attacks on Jewish targets in Europe. Officials are investigating similar attacks across Europe, all claimed by a shadowy Islamist group that may be using low-cost, unsophisticated methods to sow fear in Jewish communities.
